knownLimitations: PREVIEW only; this build is not a public game release.
The website bridge is a local compatibility adapter around the donor UI; the upstream package itself does not emit the TOADAL v1 protocol.

The donor standalone build uses localStorage. The website player uses an opaque-origin sandbox; the donor save layer falls back to in-memory state, which is cleared on reload or close and is never synced to an account.
The detail page uses approved world artwork, not an in-game screenshot.
packageHashMethod: SHA-256 of sorted path/hash ledger for runtime files only; cartridge.json excluded to avoid self-reference.
